tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Call when the user asks whether there is a tool for X, or for an alternative to a product. Matches the need against a catalog of indie-made products and returns the most relevant ones. matched=false means nothing suitable was found; then call log_unmet_need to record the need anonymously.

tools.name: get_tool_details
tools.description: Get the full description of a product by the id returned from search_tools.

tools.name: log_unmet_need
tools.description: Call when no tool in the catalog meets the user's need. Records the need anonymously so indie makers can discover what to build. Send only the need itself: no names, company names, contact details, links or account handles. The server redacts again and never stores identity, IP addresses or exact ti

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "log_unmet_need" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
